parameters.navigationObjective: Train completion likelihood first; interpretable path error only where available. Ties choose least detour. All selected U8 path denominators unknown: report nonidentification, never a path pass.
parameters.latencyObjective: Macro mean squared normalized mean error plus squared normalized SD error on U8-2/3/5 successful attempts. Ties choose smaller mean then CV. Nonnegative extra choice service, not motor/time multiplication.
parameters.distribution: Lognormal per-attempt choice latency from candidate mean/CV (scenario); no fabricated individual source subjects.
parameters.baseline: Zero extra choice latency, zero detour, 80% keyboard share, same scripts and offered work; native KLM plus unchanged wave-3 reading and interruptions.
parameters.uncalibrated: 60 per-mille detour; zero extra choice latency; 80% keyboard share.
parameters.roleTransfer: Fit U8 PCP candidate only. ED retains its independent uncalibrated profile; no PCP coefficients are borrowed. ICU pump profile has no equivalent native pump activity endpoint and stays experimental.
parameters.holdoutExecution: 10000 attempts per executable held-out script per arm; unsupported scripts produce missing/fail, never synthetic substitute times.
parameters.monteCarloPolicy: Preselect 10000; if SE exceeds gate, fail without rerunning/tuning. Pilot sample size not chosen from held-out results.
